Part open mic, part booked show.

 

Please be aware that this is an open mic night. Performers sign up online ahead of time and range from seasoned comedians to first-timers trying out. The quality of performers may vary. Some material may include adult themes, strong language, or content that may be considered offensive or inappropriate for some audiences. If you are easily offended or sensitive to certain topics, you may want to consider whether this show is right for you.

 

Interested in performing on the show? Want to see if you have what it takes to make a room full of people laugh? Have low self-esteem and want validation from strangers? Stand up comedy may be for you!

If you'd like to give it a try, you can sign up at stircrazycomedyclub.com/open-mic-sign-up.
